---
title: "New York Weather Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

weather_2010 = p8105.datasets::ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
    date < as.Date("2011-01-01")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tmin_c = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    tmax_c = as.numeric(tmax) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(tmin_c), !is.na(tmax_c))

set.seed(8105)
weather_sample = weather_2010 |>
  slice_sample(n = 1000)
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily Minimum and Maximum Temperatures

```{r temperature-scatter, echo=FALSE}
weather_sample |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin_c,
    y = ~tmax_c,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Daily minimum temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily Maximum Temperatures by Month (2010 Sample)

```{r temperature-box, echo=FALSE}
weather_sample |>
  mutate(month = format(date, "%m")) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~month, y = ~tmax_c, type = "box") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month", type = "category", categoryorder = "category ascending"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

### Mean Daily Maximum Temperature by Month (2010)

```{r temperature-bar, echo=FALSE}
weather_2010 |>
  mutate(month = format(date, "%m")) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(mean_tmax_c = mean(tmax_c)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~month, y = ~mean_tmax_c, type = "bar") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month", type = "category", categoryorder = "category ascending"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Mean daily maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```
